item.title: LSMSA to Host Public Veterans Day Ceremony Thursday, Nov. 12, Featuring Retired Army Lieutenant Colonel Dr. Brian Adams (2026-11-03)
item.description: Louisiana School for Math, Science, and the Arts (LSMSA) will host its annual Veterans Day ceremony at 4:15 p.m. on Thursday, Nov. 12, 2026, in the Northwestern State University Ballroom inside the Student Union on the NSU campus.
